title: Secret Machines adviser: genocides may be a function of the phenomenon

tellings.quote: What I find very interesting is in the Secret Machines books, the non-fiction, you've got one of the advisers just outright telling Lavenda and DeLonge, you know, "Genocides may be a function of the phenomenon. It may be trying to eliminate certain genetic strands for its own purposes."

plain: One of the advisers in the Sekret Machines books, the non-fiction series by the rock musician Tom DeLonge and the writer Peter Levenda, told the two authors that "genocides may be a function of the phenomenon," meaning the force behind UFOs, which "may be trying to eliminate certain genetic strands for its own purposes." The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this from his reading of the books. Among the books' advisers he names a man called McCasland and a General Hayden, but he does not say which of them said it.
